text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO₂), metabolic acidosis (low pH), leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, mild erythrocytosis, and mild hypoglycemia. Liver and kidney function are preserved, but alkaline phosphatase is slightly elevated. These findings suggest a severe systemic process, possibly infection/sepsis or bone marrow dysfunction, with significant respiratory compromise. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
